text: I can explain what an embedding is and why vectors from two different models must never be compared.
I can show why cosine, dot product and L2 give the same ranking for unit-length vectors.
I can size a vector index (vectors × dimensions × 4 bytes plus graph links) and say when brute force is good enough.
I can describe how HNSW builds and searches its layers and what M, efConstruction and efSearch change.
I can tune efSearch or nprobe against a brute-force ground truth and monitor recall@k over time.
I can explain why post-filtering starves selective filters and pick a fix: iterative scans, partitioning or exact search on the subset.
